sloka: ऋषीम् च तान् यथा न्यायम् महाभाग उवाच ह ।ते सर्वे हृष्ट मनसः तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम् ॥१-१८-४८॥
transliteration: ṛṣīm ca tān yathā nyāyam mahābhāga uvāca ha ।te sarve hṛṣṭa manasaḥ tasya rājño niveśanam ॥1-18-48॥

translations.english: Then the munificent king, very much (at Viswamitra's arrival) pleased offered him a happy hospitality and spoke:
